---
title: "American Birds"
format: html
---

## Load data

Read the contents of the form responses.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)

sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1e0eL4NFmGThSgUOGeWmG45urZGSrfKUgX-94tiZ6j6A/edit#gid=1253615536"

# Columns by position: C = value of X, E = estimated % of US bird species in CA
birds <- read_sheet(sheet_url) |>
  select(x = 3, ca_pct = 5) |>
  mutate(x = factor(x, levels = c(50, 70)), ca_pct = as.numeric(ca_pct))
```

## Visualize data

Visualize the two category levels and their relationship to the continuous response.

```{r}
ggplot(birds, aes(x = x, y = ca_pct)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 222)) +
  labs(
    x = "X",
    y = "What percentage of US bird species\ndo you think are found in California?"
  ) +
  theme_bw(18)
```

## Linear regression

Fit a linear regression model to the data and summarize it.

```{r}
birds_lm <- lm(ca_pct ~ x, data = birds)
summary(birds_lm)
```

## Visualize coefficients

Visualize the data with the coefficients from the model

```{r}
beta_0 <- coef(birds_lm)[1]
beta_1 <- coef(birds_lm)[2]
ggplot(birds, aes(x = x, y = ca_pct)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 222)) +
  annotate("point", x = 1, y = beta_0, size = 5, color = "cornflowerblue") +
  annotate(
    "point",
    x = 2,
    y = beta_0 + beta_1,
    size = 5,
    color = "cornflowerblue"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1.5,
    xend = 1.5,
    y = beta_0,
    yend = beta_0 + beta_1,
    linewidth = 4,
    color = "cornflowerblue"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "X",
    y = "What percentage of US bird species\ndo you think are found in California?"
  ) +
  theme_bw(18)
```
